solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Islanders queue to enter HQ

indicators.note: the queue word is said to enter, so it goes inside the headquarters word

parts.note: headquarters is a base
a queue is a line of people

explanation.surface: People queue to get into a headquarters building.
explanation.definitionFit: The Balinese are the people of Bali, an Indonesian island, so they are islanders.

clue.text: Reginald (vicar?) upset church worker

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the column over, so the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: Reg is the short form of the name Reginald
Rev, short for Reverend, is the title of a vicar

explanation.surface: A vicar named Reginald was annoyed with someone working in his church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns REGREV over, giving the answer, since this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A verger is a church official who looks after the building and leads processions.

clue.text: Winding canal I've found in foreign city

indicators.note: a winding canal twists about, so these letters are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller finds a meandering canal in some city abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Valencia is a large port city in Spain, so it is foreign from a British setter's view.

clue.text: Work with a learner to produce a gem!

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work
L is the learner plate on a British car

explanation.surface: Working with a trainee can turn out something precious.
explanation.definitionFit: An opal is an iridescent precious stone, a kind of gem.

clue.text: Small reptile spotted on American plant

parts.note: croc is a shortened crocodile, a small word for the reptile
US is the United States, so American

explanation.surface: A little lizard has been seen sitting on an American flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Small' means the reptile's name is shortened, not that the animal is little. In a down clue, 'on' means placed above.
explanation.definitionFit: The crocus is a spring-flowering bulb, a familiar garden plant.

clue.text: Upper-class fool in group of soldiers?

parts.note: U is the standard label for upper-class usage
a nit, or nitwit, is a fool

explanation.surface: A posh idiot serves among a band of soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit is a military formation, though the term covers other groups too, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Harmful recreational drug is ordered

parts.note: something harmful is bad for you
E is short for ecstasy, a recreational drug

explanation.surface: A dangerous party drug has been prescribed.
explanation.definitionFit: Bade is the past tense of bid, meaning commanded or ordered.

clue.text: A quiet member of the family, that's evident

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
a parent is a member of a family

explanation.surface: One relative is plainly a silent one.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparent and evident are synonyms: both mean plain to see.

clue.text: Carol wants love first and last, being unattached

parts.note: to carol is to sing

indicators.note: first and last asks for only the two end letters of the word love

explanation.surface: Carol, a woman who puts romance above all, is single.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carol' looks like a woman's name but is the verb, and 'first and last' takes L and E from 'love'.
explanation.definitionFit: Single, of a person, means not in a relationship, so unattached.

clue.text: Place in Somerset, a colony to the west

indicators.note: to the west says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the answer lies within the words that follow, across the word breaks

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A place in Somerset is described as a western settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft left 'in' as a link word, but it signals the hidden word. Going west reads right to left, so ETACOL is turned round. Somerset is a county in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: To locate something is to place it, find its position.

clue.text: Beloved Bambi perhaps being heard

indicators.note: being heard says the word is spoken, and a word sounding the same is entered

parts.note: Bambi, the Disney fawn, is an example of a deer

explanation.surface: A cherished cartoon fawn is being listened to.
explanation.definitionFit: Dear means loved, cherished: a synonym for beloved.

clue.text: Charlie has new pastime in temporary accommodation?

parts.note: C is Charlie in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: new tells you the word pastime is made over into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Charlie has taken up a new hobby while living in temporary lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a campsite is a place for temporary stays rather than lodging itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A campsite is where people pitch tents, a form of short-term lodging, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Having crossed valley, Maureen and Edward sat

indicators.note: the two names reach right across the valley word, so it lies between them

parts.note: Mo is a short form of Maureen
Ed is a short form of Edward
a dell is a small wooded valley

explanation.surface: Maureen and Edward crossed a valley and then sat down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sat' is not resting after a walk: it means posed for an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: To sit for a painter or photographer is to pose, that is to model, so sat means modelled.

clue.text: Gradually decreasing sound at end of recording

indicators.note: the sound word is placed at the end of the recording word, coming after it

parts.note: a tape is a recording
to ring is to sound, as a bell does

explanation.surface: A sound fades away gradually at the end of a recording.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like a noun in the surface but is the verb ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapering means narrowing or diminishing little by little.

clue.text: Item of office equipment is essential, needed by firm's bosses

parts.note: key, as an adjective, means essential
a company's board of directors are its bosses

explanation.surface: A piece of office kit is vital, and the company's directors need it.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard for typing is a standard piece of office equipment.

clue.text: Prohibition involving shout that startles monkey

indicators.note: the prohibition word involves, that is wraps around, the shout word

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition
boo is a shout made to startle someone

explanation.surface: Shouting 'boo' to scare a monkey is forbidden.
explanation.definitionFit: A baboon is a large African and Arabian monkey.

clue.text: Poet who lives in a small community in Rome?

definitions.meaning: Alexander ... was an English poet of the 18th century

definitions.text: who lives in a small community in Rome?
definitions.meaning: the ... lives in the Vatican City, a tiny state within Rome

explanation.definitionFit: Pope names both the satirical writer and the head of the Catholic Church, who resides in Vatican City.

clue.text: People on forums having no time for puzzles

indicators.note: having no says the time letter is taken away from the forum word

parts.note: people who post on online forums are posters

explanation.surface: Users of online forums with no time for brainteasers.
explanation.definitionFit: A poser is a difficult question or problem, a puzzle.

clue.text: Old city the one above all others? Not quite

indicators.note: not quite tells you the phrase is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: the one above all others is the best

explanation.surface: An ancient city almost claims to be greater than any other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not quite' drops the last T from THE BEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Thebes was a great city of ancient Egypt, and also of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Look for building to accommodate any number

indicators.note: the building is said to accommodate, that is to house, the number letter

parts.note: a hut is a small building
n stands for any number in mathematics

explanation.surface: Searching for a building big enough to house any number of people.
explanation.definitionFit: To hunt for something is to search for it.

clue.text: Function for mathematicians at home in the home counties

indicators.note: in puts the at-home word within the region's abbreviation

parts.note: SE, the South East of England, is the region holding the home counties
in means at home, as in staying in

explanation.surface: A mathematician staying at home somewhere near London.
explanation.walkthrough: The home counties are the counties surrounding London, in South East England.
explanation.definitionFit: Sine is a trigonometric function used by mathematicians.

clue.text: Shine, getting fantastic result

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wildly imagined, so the letters of result are fancifully rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone glows after getting a brilliant outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre is the gloss or sheen of a surface, so a noun meaning shine.

clue.text: Report of a snow leopard being broadcast

indicators.note: being broadcast means spoken over the air, so the answer sounds like the phrase

parts.note: the ounce is another name for the snow leopard, so a snow leopard is an ounce

explanation.surface: News of a snow leopard sighting is being aired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Report' looks like part of the snow-leopard news but is the definition; the ounce is another name for the snow leopard.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce is to make something publicly known, so the verb is a synonym of report.

clue.text: Stinking row

definitions.meaning: a line or row, as of soldiers or taxis

explanation.definitionFit: Rank is both an adjective for a strong foul smell and a noun for a line of people or things.
